summary: An unawakened body before the first breath of cultivation.
The first Body Transformation realm: tempering muscle and bone by effort alone.
Refining the flesh until it shrugs off the world's small harms.
Washing the inner organs in strength, breath by breath.
Remaking muscle fibres into cords of living power.
Hammering the skeleton into a frame that carries realms.
Major meridians form, carrying power through the body.
Deep marrow renewed; vitality wells from the bone itself.

term: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems
summary: Eight hidden gates opened one by one along the body's hidden stems.

term: Nine Stars of the Dao Palace
summary: Nine stars kindled within the palace of the self.
The first Essence Gathering realm, where Qi is drawn inward.
Qi breathes on its own; the dantian awakens.
A core turns at the centre, grinding breath into essence.
Mortal limits are broken apart and rebuilt stronger.
An inner sea of power opens beneath the spirit.
The flesh is remade in the spirit's image.
A sovereign of inner power, feared across regions.
One whose name sects whisper with reverence.
A presence that bends the world around its will.
Heaven's highest halls open to such a one.
Divinity not inherited but earned, drop by drop.
A realm spoken of in whispers, where lifespan holds no meaning.
The way of the blade: one edge, one intent.
The wood element's way: growing, adapting, enduring.
The earth element's way: heavy, immovable, sustaining.
The water element's way: yielding, patient, irresistible.
The fire element's way: burning, renewing, consuming.
The way of moments: what hastens and what outlasts.
The way of distance: what folds, what separates, what contains.
The way of causes and their inevitable returns.
The way of blood: vitality taken and spent without mercy.
The way below: the quiet that outlasts the living.
The way of far stars: light that travels without bending.
The way of emptiness: where names and forms dissolve.
Hostile (display: Hostile) - grudges held close and sharpened.
Neutral tier - a cultivator who has not yet learned your face.
Friendly tier - a warm word and an open door.
Trusted tier - secrets travel both ways.
Demonic band - a name the orthodox sects curse in private.
Neutral band - neither virtue nor vice marks your name.
Righteous band - one whose conduct the upright world praises.
Qi stirs in the waking earth.
Heat thickens the air and tempers the body.
Frost edges the wind; insight sharpens.
Stillness deepens; cultivation settles like snow.
